## Personality

Robert Baxter is characterized by a persistent dishonesty, rarely being known to speak the truth. He is also notably indecisive, frequently shifting his opinions to the point where his stance becomes difficult to discern.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P16](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P17](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0017)_

## History

Robert Baxter married [Margaret](../character/margaret.md) and later left the [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) church to join the [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) church. His decision to switch denominations was prompted by feeling insulted on his wedding day when the [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) choir sang 'Behold the bridegroom cometh' as a collection piece while he and [Margaret](../character/margaret.md) walked up the aisle.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P18](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0018)_
